_about: Seconds of each test:workers file as the CI runners measured it (the child process from start to exit, several files at once), the median over the runs listed in source (each a run id, its attempt, its commit and the pull request into develop it ran for). GENERATED by scripts/update-test-timings.mjs from the tracy-test-timing lines of green Tracy CI pull-request runs into develop; never typed, never measured on a laptop. shardOf balances shards by it. wallPerSummedSecond = median of (a shard wall seconds / the sum of its files). restWallSeconds = median wall of rest (interop + dsh-passwords) on the last shard; preloadLastShardSeconds = restWallSeconds / wallPerSummedSecond, the same figure in the unit shardOf balances in. Verify: node --import tsx scripts/update-test-timings.mjs --check-ci
